descriptions.practice: Masalalar, amaliy loyihalar va bilim testlari.
descriptions.practice-problems: Masala yeching va kodingizni testlarda tekshiring.
descriptions.practice-projects: Talablar bo‘yicha loyiha tuzing va fayllarini yuboring.
descriptions.practice-tests: Mavzuli savollarga javob bering va natijangizni ko‘ring.
descriptions.battles-duels: Masalalar to‘plamida boshqa dasturchi bilan bellashing.
descriptions.competitions-contests: Vaqt chegarasi va umumiy natijalar jadvaliga ega dasturlash musobaqalari.
descriptions.competitions-arena: Ketma-ket savol-javob bellashuvlarida arena ochkolarini to‘plang.
descriptions.competitions-tournaments: Duellarda g‘alaba qozonib turnirning keyingi bosqichiga o‘ting.
